description: On the Phi3 LongRoPE path, the evaluation width can disagree with the load-time width used to choose rotary factors.
trigger: Use a Phi3 LongRoPE configuration and a valid evaluation length on the opposite side of its original-context threshold from 2048; for example, choose a width above the threshold when the threshold is at least 2048.
expected_behavior: For a context-length evaluation, choose factors using the requested width, or explicitly constrain the evaluation to the intended tier.
actual_behavior: The evaluator still passes 2048 into `Phi3Config.override_dynamic_seq_len`; LongRoPE selects its factors using that override, not the requested window width. In the example trigger it selects short factors even though the requested row exceeds the threshold.

verification.description: Followed the override from the evaluator to the config field and compared it with the LongRoPE `a_override > b` condition.
verification.limits: This is conditional on the LongRoPE path and a crossed threshold; no checkpoint or score was tested.

introductions.rationale: The width becomes caller-selectable while the evaluator still supplies 2048 for the Phi3 dynamic sequence length override.
